# fabric_slice (Data Source)

Look up a FABRIC slice by `slice_id`, `id`, or `name` using the FABRIC orchestrator. When multiple arguments are set, `slice_id` takes precedence over `id`, and `id` takes precedence over `name`.

## Example Usage

### By slice ID

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fabric = {
      source  = "Testbed-IAC/fabric"
      version = ">= 0.1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "fabric_token" {
  description = "FABRIC ID token (JWT). Set via TF_VAR_fabric_token. Do not commit."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "slice_id" {
  description = "FABRIC slice UUID from the portal or orchestrator slice list."
  type        = string
}

provider "fabric" {
  token = var.fabric_token
}

# Look up a slice by UUID. slice_id takes precedence over id, and id over name.
data "fabric_slice" "by_id" {
  slice_id = var.slice_id
}

output "slice_state" {
  value = data.fabric_slice.by_id.state
}
```

### By name

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    fabric = {
      source  = "Testbed-IAC/fabric"
      version = ">= 0.1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "fabric_token" {
  description = "FABRIC ID token (JWT). Set via TF_VAR_fabric_token. Do not commit."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "slice_name" {
  description = "Slice name to look up. Resolves the first matching non-deleted slice."
  type        = string
}

provider "fabric" {
  token = var.fabric_token
}

# Look up a slice by name. When several slices share a name, the first
# non-deleted match is returned.
data "fabric_slice" "by_name" {
  name = var.slice_name
}

output "slice_id" {
  value = data.fabric_slice.by_name.slice_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) FABRIC slice identifier used for lookup or assigned by the orchestrator after lookup.
- `name` (String) Slice name used for lookup or returned by the orchestrator after lookup.
- `slice_id` (String) FABRIC slice identifier used for lookup or assigned by the orchestrator after lookup.

### Read-Only

- `graph_id` (String) Topology graph identifier assigned by FABRIC.
- `lease_end_time` (String) Lease end time assigned by FABRIC and normalized by the provider.
- `lease_start_time` (String) Lease start time assigned by FABRIC and normalized by the provider.
- `state` (String) Current slice state assigned by the orchestrator.
